subject: URGENT Avicenna Data Issues
body:
Dear Brandon,

I've thoroughly investigated the reported cases. It looks like the participant with ID 97279 had their app killed in the background for a couple of hours but then restarted it, so we're now receiving data from them again.

For the participant with ID 98989, it seems their device frequently runs out of battery and turns off. Since we can't reopen the app automatically when the device restarts, we don't capture any data until they manually open the app again.

A similar issue is happening with the participant with ID 96989. However, it seems they eventually turned their device back on and reopened the app, so we're now receiving data from them as well.

Please also note there might be a delay of up to 3 hours in receiving data from participant devices for some data sources. As a result, the data you see in the exports might not fully reflect the current state of data collection.

Best regards,
Pouya
